{{Otheruses|Thorn}}
{{Youmay|the poisonous plant from the Kur forest|[[Thorn-vine|the plant]] used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]}}
'''Thorn vines''' were poisonous [[Vine/Legends|plants]] native to the [[Kur forests]]. They could cause severe injury to individuals that were cut by them, and left black scars. [[Casti Tholon]] had thorn vine scars across her arms, legs, and head.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
